comment: Image versions of the SCS 3.3.2 refresh (November 2026): the September 2026 solver releases (each row records them in metadata.runtime) and the numpy/scipy the September manifests record, on the CPU images; highspy as the refresh ran it on the GPU, PDLP, cuOpt and QTQP GPU images; cuOpt 26.8.0. Use with SCS_PYTHON_REF set to the scs-python commit under test (91df3fcd for the CPU runs, 13a25e84 for the SCS GPU re-run and the Clarabel fill shards).
